      18              : /// \brief Ego motion compensation for moving sensor platforms
      19              : ///
      20              : /// This class implements ego motion compensation for object tracking systems where the sensor
      21              : /// platform (typically a vehicle) is moving. It handles the geometric and kinematic transformations
      22              : /// required to compensate for the ego vehicle's motion when tracking objects in the environment.
      23              : ///
      24              : /// The implementation is based on circular motion equations and includes:
      25              : /// - Position compensation for objects relative to moving ego vehicle
      26              : /// - Direction compensation for velocity vectors
      27              : /// - Error propagation for uncertainty in motion parameters using UDU decomposition
      28              : /// - Special handling for small angular velocities to avoid numerical issues
      29              : /// - Support for both full and factored covariance matrix representations
      30              : ///
      31              : /// Mathematical Background:
      32              : /// - Circular motion with yaw rate ω and speed v for time T
      33              : /// - Secant approximation for small angular displacements
      34              : /// - First-order error propagation for uncertainty in motion parameters
      35              : /// - UDU decomposition for numerical stability in covariance calculations
      36              : /// - Specialized equations for ω→0 limit to maintain numerical stability
